About US

At Nairobi Central Hardware Ltd, our primary mission is to create opportunities for you and to enhance our communities. To achieve this, we deliver high-quality general hardware and safety-wear products used in construction, manufacturing, home improvement, plumbing, and agriculture.

Our management philosophy is centered around building a strong, sustainable relationship with you, and our entire business set-up is designed to make transactions easy and efficient. Come realize your vision at Nairobi Central Hardware Ltd.

Meet our Founder

Adarsh Gudka

Adarsh Gudka is the Founder and CEO of Nairobi Central Hardware Ltd. Since founding the company in 2013, he has worked to expand the product line by sourcing quality products from China and India as well as streamline sales and operations. He has a B.E. in Electronics and Communication from RV Engineering College in Bengaluru, India.

title: Nairobi Central Hardware Ltd
html:
Nairobi Central Hardware is a reliable supplier of high-quality plumbing tools, farm tools, and safety wear products in Nairobi, Kenya. The company is committed to providing its clients with the best possible products and services to meet their specific needs.

If you are a plumbing contractor or a DIY enthusiast looking for reliable plumbing tools, Nairobi Central Hardware is the place to go. They offer a wide range of plumbing products, including pipes, fittings, valves, and pumps. Their experienced staff can help you choose the right tools for your plumbing project, whether you are working on a small home repair or a large commercial installation.

For farmers and agricultural workers, Nairobi Central Hardware offers a variety of farm tools to make your work easier and more efficient. From tractors and plows to hand tools such as hoes and machetes, they have everything you need to get the job done right. They also offer a selection of safety wear products to protect you from potential hazards on the job.

Safety is a top priority for Nairobi Central Hardware, and they understand the importance of having the right safety wear products when working in construction, manufacturing, home improvement, plumbing, and agriculture. We offer a variety of safety wear products, including hard hats, safety glasses, gloves, and work boots, to keep you safe on the job.

Overall, Nairobi Central Hardware is a trusted supplier of plumbing tools, farm tools, and safety wear products in Nairobi. With their commitment to quality and customer service, you can trust them to provide you with the right tools and products to get the job done safely and efficiently.

title: Best Ideal Products From Nairobi Central Hardware Limited
html:
Nairobi Central Hardware Limited is a leading hardware store in Nairobi, Kenya, with over one decade of experience in the industry. We pride ourselves on providing high-quality hardware products to our clients, ranging from individual homeowners to corporate entities. We stock a wide range of products, making us the one-stop-shop for all your hardware needs.

Paint Brushes

Painting is an essential part of any construction or renovation project, and Nairobi Central Hardware Limited has a wide range of paint brushes suitable for different painting tasks. Our paint brushes come in different sizes and shapes, ensuring that you have the right brush for the job.

Building Tools

Building tools are necessary for any construction project, and Nairobi Central Hardware Limited stocks a comprehensive range of building tools, including hammers, saws, chisels, and trowels, among others. Our building tools are of high quality, making them suitable for any construction task.

Electrical Fittings

At Nairobi Central Hardware Limited, we understand the importance of having high-quality electrical fittings, including switches, sockets, and cables. That is why we only stock electrical fittings from reputable manufacturers who meet the required safety standards.

Cleaning Items

Keeping your home or workspace clean is essential for health and safety, and Nairobi Central Hardware Limited has a wide range of cleaning items to help you achieve this. Our cleaning items range from brooms and mops to ensuring that you have everything you need to maintain a clean and hygienic space.

Farming Tools

Farming is a vital sector in Kenya, and Nairobi Central Hardware Limited stocks a range of farming tools, such as hoes, machetes, and sickles. Our farming tools are of high quality and built to last, making them suitable for the tough conditions of farming.

Furniture Fittings

We understand that furniture fittings are crucial for anyone in the furniture business, and that is why we stock a range of furniture fittings, including handles, knobs, and hinges. Our furniture fittings come in different sizes and finishes to suit your needs.

Fasteners

Fasteners are essential for any construction or renovation project, and Nairobi Central Hardware Limited stocks a range of fasteners, including screws, bolts, and nuts. Our fasteners are of high quality and come in different sizes and finishes to suit your needs.

Gardening Tools

If you love gardening, Nairobi Central Hardware Limited stocks a range of gardening tools, such as shovels, spades, and rakes. Our gardening tools are of high quality and suitable for different gardening tasks.

Hand Tools

Hand tools are essential for any construction or renovation project, and Nairobi Central Hardware Limited stocks a range of hand tools, including pliers, hammers,wrenches, and screwdrivers. Our hand tools are of high quality and suitable for different building tasks.

Plumbing Tools

Plumbing tools are essential for any plumbing system installation or repair, and Nairobi Central Hardware Limited stocks a range of plumbing tools, including pipe wrenches,G.I fittings, pipe cutters, and pliers. Our plumbing tools are of high quality and suitable for different plumbing tasks.

PPR Fittings

PPR fittings are essential for plumbing systems, and Nairobi Central Hardware Limited stocks a range of PPR fittings, including couplers, elbows, and tees. Our PPR fittings are of high quality and come in different sizes and finishes to suit your needs.

Pressure Pipe Fittings

Pressure pipe fittings are essential for plumbing and irrigation systems, and Nairobi Central Hardware Limited stocks a range of pressure pipe fittings, including reducers, couplings, and tees. Our pressure pipe fittings are of high quality and suitable for different plumbing and irrigation tasks.

Safety Wear

Safety wear is essential for anyone working in construction, farming, or industrial settings, and Nairobi Central Hardware Limited stocks a range of safety wear, including safety boots, helmets, and gloves. Our safety wear is of high quality and meets the required safety standards to protect workers from workplace hazards.

Spanners

Spanners are essential hand tools for any construction or renovation project, and Nairobi Central Hardware Limited stocks a range of spanners, including adjustable spanners, combination spanners, and socket spanners. Our spanners are of high quality and suitable for different building tasks.

Waste Fittings

Waste fittings are essential for any plumbing system, and Nairobi Central Hardware Limited stocks a range of waste fittings, including traps, connectors, and plugs. Our waste fittings are of high quality and come in different sizes and finishes to suit your needs.

Wire Products

Wire products are essential for any construction or renovation project, and Nairobi Central Hardware Limited stocks a range of wire products, including binding wire, chicken wire, and barbed wire. Our wire products are of high quality and suitable for different construction and fencing tasks.

Nairobi Central Hardware Limited is your one-stop-shop for high-quality hardware products. We stock a wide range of products suitable for different construction, plumbing, farming, and industrial tasks. Our products are of high quality, and we source them from reputable manufacturers who meet the required safety standards. Visit us today and get all the hardware products you need for your project.
